security: Every job that runs on a pull request, an issue or a comment checks out with persist-credentials: false.
Every agent step runs with isolate-agent.
The agent action is pinned to a release, not to a moving ref.
automation: Agent steps set repo-skills so the agent loads the repository's own skills from the default branch, on the triggers this repository allows: schedule and workflow_dispatch always, and issues, comments and pull requests only from an owner, member or collaborator on a same-repository head.
Each job resolves its agent model once through the agent-model resolver, before its first agent step, and no agent step reads a model variable directly.
The agent reviews pull requests opened by the fro-bot user, which GitHub cannot request a review for.
A prompt dispatched to the repository's agent is routed to a branch and a pull request, not kept comment-only and not run in a discarded working directory.
Renovate Approve applies only to a repository that uses Renovate automerge.
developerExperience: The repository has an AGENTS.md that states the rules its agent works under; the agent holds every ask in this brief against it and may decline or counter.
